votes.motion: Issue an enforcement order for Hickory Hills Lake Association to remove gravel from shoreline within 30 days
votes.quote: jr moved to issue an enforcement order that the hickory hills lake association use any method available to remove the gravel noted specifically in the email request and that occur within the next 30 days. mr dwyer asked for amendment to the motion that any matting necessary be placed to prevent tracks being left into the lake bottom. bp noted that the lakebed in that area is all gravel. mr fortune noted the excavator would be on dry ground along the shoreline. td asked if there was a way we could keep it in the motion for just in case purposes. cl wanted to know why we couldn't issue it as an emergency cert with an rda follow up. rb noted in an emergency certification there had to be an overriding public issue. simply pulling the boats out of the water is not an overriding public need. td ask if the hickory hills land owners association could add a page to the lake management plan outlining this procedure. this way in the future, there did not need to be repeated appearances to the conservation commission. rb seconded the motion and the commission voted unanimously to approve
